## Student 500

Published version: **0.4.5** · [Release](https://github.com/ScriptSavvy/AustraliaVisaSkills/releases/tag/Subclass500)

### 0.4.5 — 2026-11-16
- Added precise onshore and family exemption conditions, including course completion, progression, provider default and linked current-family visas.
- Corrected the PhD package screen and kept the progression class's one-further-course restriction separate.
- Refreshed targeted legislative coverage while preserving earlier applications and unresolved case-specific questions.
- Bundled the common usage guide and skill-specific prompts, with an optional ZIP-in-chat installation route for agents that support it.

### 0.4.4 — 2026-11-14
- Simplified adaptive intake to numbered questions without unknown or estimated totals.
- Added a one-time explanation, exact totals for known question sets, and continuous follow-up numbering.
- Added both CLI and ZIP installation options to the bundled guides.
- Updated original-content attribution to Immigent®.

### 0.4.3
- Focused questions now receive a direct answer, the specific supported problem and concrete next actions without a full questionnaire or report by default.
- Broad reviews now start with main findings and priority actions; important uncertainty remains visible.
- Clarified that arrival deadlines, visa expiry and permitted stay must be read separately from the actual visa record.

### 0.4.2
- Added question numbering and exact or estimated totals, with explanations when the total changes.
- Added a brief first-use CC BY-NC 4.0 non-commercial licence notice before applicant intake.

### 0.4.1
- Applicant intake now asks one question at a time, adapting to answers and avoiding repeated questions.
- Supports unsure/skipped answers, urgent-request priority and a grouped questionnaire only when the applicant explicitly prefers it.

### 0.4.0
- Added application records, document alternatives, correspondence/request handling and relevant terms.
- Deepened newborn/change checks while preserving application-date and family-route limits.

### 0.3.0
- Expanded detailed preparation guidance and clarified current-rule verification.
- Added application-date checks for the October 2026 onshore and family changes; unresolved exceptions remain flagged.

### 0.2.1 — 2026-10-07
- Updated source-verification notes. No changes to preparation requirements.

### 0.2.0 — 2026-10-07
- Added installation and usage guides.
- Simplified preparation reports and clarified privacy and legal notices.
- Added CC BY-NC 4.0 licensing for original skill content.

## Employer-sponsored visas — 482, 186, 494 and transitional 187 (191 evidence handoff)

Published version: **0.2.2** · [Release](https://github.com/ScriptSavvy/AustraliaVisaSkills/releases/tag/Employer_Sponsored_Visas)

### 0.2.2 — 2026-11-20
- Offer an optional redacted résumé or short typed summary when several work-history details are needed. Use it to organise a preliminary timeline and ask only about the next material gap. A résumé does not replace required evidence.

### 0.2.1 — 2026-11-20
- Fix download links and the optional update check to use the Employer-Sponsored Visas release. If you installed version 0.2.0, update manually from that release page.
- Clarify how to switch from the former standalone subclass 482 skill. Visa-preparation guidance is unchanged.

### 0.2.0 — 2026-11-20
- Unify subclass 482, 186 and 494 nomination and visa preparation in one employer-sponsored skill. Include a separate 187 transitional TRT workflow and a 494 → 191 evidence handoff, not a full 191 assessment.
- Add standard business sponsorship applications, renewal and accreditation; labour agreement requests and variations; ongoing sponsor obligations; and worker-protection and sponsor-charge checks.
- Add a 482 → 186 TRT evidence handoff that keeps visa holding and qualifying employment separate.
